candidates.tagline: The $9 lollipop that plays music into your skull — earplugs sold separately
candidates.story: Lollipop Star debuted at CES 2026 as a single-use bone-conduction candy that beams celebrity songs through your jawbone to your inner ear, but only if you also wear earplugs to block ambient noise — after one session you throw away a plastic stick containing a lithium battery and a circuit board.
candidates.why_funny: The 'Worst in Show' at CES 2026: you eat a $9 lollipop, plug your ears, and chew for music — the candy IS the speaker, the landfill IS the packaging.
candidates.alt: Colorful Lollipop Star bone-conduction candy sticks displayed at CES 2026

candidates.tagline: Samsung's 'Bespoke' fridge is no longer bespoke — now comes with ads instead
candidates.story: Samsung's Bespoke AI Family Hub fridge (the name literally means 'custom-made') built its $3,500 brand on swappable door panels to match your kitchen — then on July 1, 2026, Samsung quietly removed interchangeable panels from all new models, while also showing banner ads for Tide on a screen you cannot fully disable.
candidates.why_funny: A fridge named 'Bespoke' that removed customization and added ads: the only thing bespoke about it now is the price.
candidates.alt: Samsung smart refrigerator with large touchscreen display on the door
